description: Map the pipeline record_type to a normalized genomic scope (complete_genome/capsid/vp1_complete/vp1_partial/other_fragment/unknown). POLIOVIRUS ONLY: record_type is derived against Sabin VP1 coordinates and is literally 'other' for every non-polio EV record, so a non-polio row projects 'unknown' (no determination was made) rather than asserting 'other_fragment' (a determination that it is a fragment) -- 1,764 of those rows are >=6,000 nt.
Use dataset_partition as the mutually exclusive canonical virus group (poliovirus vs non_polio_enterovirus).

Poliovirus uses the canonical coverage-guarded serotype: the sequence serotype iff serotype_sequence_confident AND sequence_capsid_aa_compared >= 100 codons AND not an intra-capsid recombinant (VP1 == capsid serotype), else the curated text serotype -- build_final_carve.canonical_serotype, ONE shared definition with the v1 carve. Non-polio EV uses the name-derived enterovirus_type first; if the name type is absent, a confident enterovirus_type_sequence may supply the canonical value; a sequence call never overwrites an existing name-derived type.
Use classification_reconciled for poliovirus; blank outside poliovirus.
Poliovirus shipped carve is vouched; non-polio EV is provisional; carve-excluded records are excluded (audit only).
Project the curated origin_class.
Project the curated sampling_frame.
Project the curated specimen_type.

Precision-driven and curated-first, so a superseded source value can never resurrect: day -> collection_date_curated (ISO YYYY-MM-DD); month -> the source /collection_date normalized to YYYY-MM (the curated layer has no month field, so this is a normalization of the source, not a fallback to it, and the normalized year is cross-checked against collection_year_curated); year -> collection_year_curated (YYYY); range -> collection_year_curated, which holds the R-DATE-RANGE-1 midpoint, never the raw interval string; unknown -> blank. Every emitted value matches ^[0-9]{4}(-[0-9]{2}(-[0-9]{2})?)?$.
Project the curated collection_date_precision (day/month/year/range/unknown).

For an interval /collection_date, the exact endpoint years, populated IFF collection_date_precision == 'range' and blank on every other row. collection_date carries the midpoint (floor of the mean of the endpoints), so the point estimate is usable without string parsing while the true bounds stay recoverable. Upstream producer: build_curated_genbank_metadata.parse_date_range / range_midpoint_year.
Project the reviewed engineered/construct boolean.

Sub-admin1 detail only. parse_geo derives country/admin1/locality from one GenBank geo_loc_name string, so locality was byte-identical to admin1 whenever no finer detail was deposited (4,285 of 5,319 rows; containment is exact -- locality always startswith admin1). Blank it when it equals admin1 so a non-blank locality means genuine sub-admin1 information.
Records with a carve exclusion are absent from canonical but remain in source and audit.

Divergence-from-Sabin threshold above which a record's raw sequence tier is 'wild' (classify_sequence_tier.WILD_THRESHOLD = 0.15; the identical value is reused, not reinvented, by resolve_recombinant_segments.py and resolve_capsid_free_sabin_like_serotype.py).
Per-serotype divergence-from-Sabin threshold below which a record's raw sequence tier is 'Sabin-like' (classify_sequence_tier.SABIN_LIKE_THRESHOLD = {'1': 0.01, '2': 0.006, '3': 0.01}).

Capsid AA p-distance band adjudicating the ambiguous generic-organism poliovirus-membership bucket: below 8.0% with >=50 codons compared rescues to poliovirus; 15.0% or above confirms not-poliovirus (resolve_poliovirus_membership.py).
Capsid AA p-distance band used to reconcile text-derived vs sequence-derived classification (reconcile_sequence_classification.AA_BAND = 0.08; minimum 50 codons compared to make a call).
Minimum within-type VP1 nucleotide identity for a confident sequence-derived EV type call (resolve_ev_sequence_typing.NT_THRESHOLD = 0.75).
Minimum co-aligned overlap in nt for a confident sequence-derived EV type call (resolve_ev_sequence_typing.MIN_OVERLAP_NT = 250).
Minimum overlap in nt for the mislabeled-polio review surface, below the confident-call floor (resolve_ev_sequence_typing.POLIO_SUSPECT_MIN_OVERLAP_NT = 50).
Minimum shared 12-mer containment for a reference to be aligned during escalated EV typing (resolve_ev_sequence_typing.KMER_PREFILTER = 0.3).
Number of same-type references aligned when reconfirming a query's own name-derived type (resolve_ev_sequence_typing.TOPK_SAME_TYPE = 1).
Number of top-ranked references (by 12-mer containment) aligned during all-vs-panel EV typing escalation (resolve_ev_sequence_typing.TOPK_ALL = 8).

Window-scoring parameters for detecting a Sabin/wild recombination breakpoint: 60nt divergence windows, >=3 low-divergence windows to call a Sabin segment, >=2 high-divergence windows to call a chimera, >=150nt minimum Sabin-segment length (resolve_recombinant_segments.py). Detection does NOT re-tier: as of 2026-07-29 the segment-divergence tier override is removed (it could source a tier from outside the classification region), and the only tier this step writes is 'chimera'.

A detected junction is relabelled tier 'chimera' -- the threshold rule has no defined input -- when VP1 diverges >=2.0x its own whole-capsid p-distance (above the serotype Sabin-like threshold), or the capsid-AA membership band fails so a Sabin segment sits in a non-poliovirus capsid (resolve_recombinant_segments.CHIMERA_VP1_CAPSID_RATIO).
Ceiling divergence for promoting a capsid-free record to a Sabin-like serotype (resolve_capsid_free_sabin_like_serotype.EGREGIOUS_CEILING = 0.25; minimum segment length 150nt).
Minimum capsid codons compared for the sequence-derived serotype to be trusted as the shipped canonical serotype (build_final_carve.MIN_SEROTYPE_CODONS = 100).

Precision is the shape of the GenBank /collection_date qualifier: day, month, year, or range. A record that deposited no date has no precision and projects NA. This supersedes R-DATE-PRECISION-1, which projected the curated collection_date_precision and used 'unknown' for 2,805 dateless records while giving 1,764 others a year recovered from outside GenBank. Nothing in raw/ separates those two groups, so the split cannot be reproduced and guessing it would fabricate 4,569 values. NA also frees 'unknown' to mean what it says: a date exists but its precision is unclear.

Precision-driven and source-derived: day and month precision emit the ISO normalization of the GenBank /collection_date, year emits the year, and range emits the midpoint (floor of the mean of the endpoint years). A record with no date emits blank, so collection_date is blank if and only if collection_date_precision is NA. Every emitted value matches ^[0-9]{4}(-[0-9]{2}(-[0-9]{2})?)?$. An active collection_year_curated decision wins outright, which is what keeps a rejected submitter date from being reinstated. This supersedes R-DATE-1, whose curated-first branches are not reachable from raw/ alone.
